MANAGE.DESCRIPTION: Create and review the WhatsApp templates of this inbox. Templates must be approved by Meta before they can be used in campaigns.

MANAGE.PREVIEW_HINT: Select a template to see the preview.

FORM.TITLE: New template

NAME.LABEL: Name
NAME.HELP: Only lowercase letters, numbers and underscore.

LANGUAGE.LABEL: Language
LANGUAGE.HELP: Language code, e.g. pt_BR or en_US.

BODY.LABEL: Text
BODY.PLACEHOLDER: Hi {'{{'}1{'}}'}, your order {'{{'}2{'}}'} is on its way.
BODY.HELP: Use {'{{'}1{'}}'}, {'{{'}2{'}}'}... for variables, in order. The text cannot start or end with a variable.

FOOTER.LABEL: Footer (optional)
FOOTER.PLACEHOLDER: Short note, up to 60 characters, no variables

FORM.SUCCESS: Template sent to Meta. Status: {status}. Approval can take from minutes to 24 hours.
FORM.GENERIC_ERROR: Could not create the template. Please try again.

TIPS.TITLE: Before you send
TIPS.CATEGORY: Marketing or utility: Meta reviews the category and may reclassify the template.
TIPS.COST: Cost per send: marketing templates cost more than utility ones and are charged per delivered message.
TIPS.APPROVAL: Approval time: from a few minutes up to 24 hours.
TIPS.PROMOTION: Do not create promotional templates as utility. Meta may reject or reclassify them.

ERRORS.NON_SEQUENTIAL_VARIABLES: Variables must be sequential, starting at {'{{'}1{'}}'}, without skipping numbers.
ERRORS.VARIABLE_AT_EDGE: The text cannot start or end with a variable.
ERRORS.MISSING_EXAMPLES: Fill in an example for each variable.
ERRORS.TOO_MANY_VARIABLES: The header accepts only one variable, {'{{'}1{'}}'}.
ERRORS.MIXED_TYPES: Do not mix quick replies and link buttons.
ERRORS.INVALID_URL: Use a full https link. A variable is only allowed as {'{{'}1{'}}'} at the end.
